english.title: Goods vehicle - fail to notify conviction to traffic commissioner

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS ACT 1995

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having made an application for an operator's licence, knowingly failed to notify the Traffic Commissioner to whom the application was made that a notifiable conviction had occurred
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(3)(a) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) Section 51 provides an extended time limit for bringing proceedings by applying section 6 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 to this offence.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who had made an application for an operator's licence, failed to notify the Traffic Commissioner that a notifiable conviction had occurred in the interval between the making of the application and the date of its disposal. On **(..SPECIFY DATE OF CONVICTION..) **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was convicted of **(..SPECIFY OFFENCE(S)..).
